english.title: Cause / permit a vehicle other than taxi to stand on an authorised standing on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9.2 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
